en: The postcard features a black and white illustration of two military officers or monarchs shaking hands in an ornately decorated room with large mirrors and richly detailed furniture. Both men are in elaborate dress uniforms adorned with medals and sashes. There is a signature 'F.W. Frankel' with the year '1914' on the bottom right. At the bottom of the image, a quote in German is printed.
